name: OTSR
summary: Lab white and near-black with a copper signal; square corners, a few chamfered edges; system fonts, monospace micro-labels; square status marks; a dot field as texture.

color._note: Hex sRGB; each role has a light and a dark value. A fill tone is for areas and strokes. A text tone is the same hue pulled to >= 4.5:1 on surface.base and surface.raised. Use the text tone whenever the colour carries letters, or sits under letters of the opposite colour.

sunken.role: a well, an input, a secondary area

raised.role: panels, cards, popovers; may be 86% translucent over the base

inverse.role: panel heads and solid buttons: the other mode's base

muted.role: secondary text, fill tone (3.6:1 on raised in light)

mutedText.role: secondary text where it must reach 4.5:1 on surface.raised; light needs the pull, dark already passes

faint.role: disabled, placeholders, key caps; never carries information

strong.role: the edge of a primary outlined button: ink, not grey

signal._note: There is one accent. Copper is the fill AND the label colour of the source design (3:1 as letters on lab white, by choice). The text-safe tones below are for targets that must meet AA; the source look uses copper and onCopper only. See README, rule 2.

copper.role: the accent: active states, focus rings, link underlines, square marks, the cursor

copperBright.role: hover on a copper fill; the bright-blue ANSI slot

copperSoft.role: tint behind an active or hovered control; flatten over surface.base when alpha cannot be used

copperText.role: copper that carries text, or carries white text in light mode (4.5:1 as text, 5.4:1 under white); in dark mode the fill tone is already readable as text

copperDeep.role: copper under WHITE text in dark mode, when a component insists on white-on-accent (about 5:1)

onCopper.role: text on a copper fill: white in light, BLACK in dark; never white on the pale dark copper

okFill.role: success area that carries white text; the pale dark green cannot

danger.role: error, destructive; already >= 4.5:1 as text on both bases

warning.role: there is no separate warning colour: warnings are copper

info.role: there is no blue: information is muted ink

dot.role: the dot field behind the main stage, at the source strength

vignette.role: edge fades on the stage: none in light, strong in dark

shadow.role: only for the one floating stage or dialog; panels get a hairline (line.default), not a shadow

chrome.role: browser theme-color, status bar, title bar: the base surface

type.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
type.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

micro.role: labels of tabs, panel heads, keys, status words

controlLabel.role: the label inside a button or tab

bilingual.role: OTSR labels carry a second line (Traditional Chinese) under the English term: 9px, letter-spacing 0.18em, 72% opacity. Only where the host UI is bilingual.

shape._note: Square. Up to 2px is tolerated where 0 looks broken (focus rings, images). Full circles stay only for avatars and spinners.

chamfer.role: top-right and bottom-left corners cut, on a FEW elements: primary buttons, the main input, the user's own message, the tab strip. Not on everything; not on containers whose children may overflow, because clip-path clips them.

marks.role: status dots are squares; a blinking square means running

border.role: every clickable thing has an edge, a fill on hover, or both

effects.focus: outline 2px signal.copper, offset 3px; never a soft glow
effects.link: ink colour, underlined in copper, underline offset 3px; copper on hover

motion.stepped: steps(2) for blinking marks; no easing flourishes

effects.elevation: hairline over shadow; one shadow only, on the floating stage

terminal._note: ANSI palette: only the blue slots and the base colours are the theme's; the other ANSI colours stay as the host has them.
